rgdbscan_empty_cluster_policy.paper: Table6 and Section4 specify monotone spread growth over three positions; no explicit empty-cluster policy.
rgdbscan_empty_cluster_policy.implementation: Empty centers give NaN spread; strict-growth predicate is false. Finite UPV may be accepted. Missing UPV is still rejected. One center gives zero spread.
rgdbscan_empty_cluster_policy.status: Explicit unresolved convention, not claimed as recovered author behavior. No new rejection rule or test-based retuning introduced.
rgdbscan_empty_cluster_policy.limitation: High min_samples relative to trajectory count can weaken spread detection. Cluster-count attribution of archived-profile full coverage was not measured.
